Your first month is on results.

If you've got 1,000 or more subscribers and customers who've opted in to hear from you, I'll set up the welcome email and send these campaigns, plus one more, to that list across Black Friday and the lead-up to Christmas. I owned my own cafés for close to a decade. Business owner to business owner, I wouldn't put this forward if I didn't think it would pay for itself.
